mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 49 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. The moon is in its First Quarter phase tonight. Looking ahead, the overnight low will reach 45 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the 2027 budget. Additionally, the Public Works Department reminds everyone to keep our sewer system healthy by properly disposing of fats, oils, and grease, as these items can cause serious clogs and environmental pollution.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, attend yoga at Insight Wellness, or grab pizza and a pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, Wednesday Trivia Night is at the Bogey Factory tomorrow, followed by Art House 360 events and Hop Haus Trivia, also tomorrow.

Turning to our weekly police update, on November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue, which resulted in an O W I arrest involving a passenger under the age of sixteen.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The Culver's in Verona is currently open, but please note that they will be closing their doors soon at 10:00 PM, so make sure to get there quickly if you are craving a sweet treat.
